title: Preallocate column-scan data prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when column-scan fast paths build data:<table>: scan prefixes from known table-name length.
implementation: Added column_scan_data_prefix_for_table() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:.
Replaced COUNT DISTINCT and SELECT DISTINCT data-prefix construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: Column-scan data-prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving aggregate and distinct query behavior.
